identity.title: Detection of N<SUB>2</SUB>D<SUP>+</SUP> in a Protoplanetary Disk

paper_type_evidence.quote: Based on ALMA Cycle 2 observations toward the disk around the T Tauri star AS 209, we report the first detection of N$_2$D$^+$ (J=3-2) in a protoplanetary disk.

evidence.quote: In this letter, we present the first detection of N$_2$D$^+$ in a protoplanetary disk.
